library(dplyr)
## 
## Attaching package: 'dplyr'
## The following objects are masked from 'package:stats':
## 
##     filter, lag
## The following objects are masked from 'package:base':
## 
##     intersect, setdiff, setequal, union
branch_length <- function(filePath, cell_line){

  branches <- read.table(filePath, header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  

  internal_rows <- grep("internal", branches$V1)
  
#deleting first internal:
  if(length(internal_rows) > 0){
    branches <- branches[-internal_rows[1], ]
  }
  

  result <- data.frame(
    cell = branches$V1,
    total_branch_length = branches$V2,
    clone = cell_line,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  result <- result[!grepl("internal", result$cell), ]
  
  return(result)
}



kuramochi_C8  <- branch_length("Medicc2Results/mcs_Kuramochi_C8_1000kb_branch_lengths.tsv",  "Kuramochi_C8")
kuramochi_E10 <- branch_length("Medicc2Results/mcs_Kuramochi_E10_1000kb_branch_lengths.tsv", "Kuramochi_E10")
kuramochi_parent <- branch_length("Medicc2Results/mcs_Kuramochi_parent_1000kb_branch_lengths.tsv", "Kuramochi_Parent")

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(kuramochi_df, aes(x = cell, y = total_branch_length, color = clone)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) + 
  facet_wrap(~clone, scales = "free_x") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(title = "Kuramochi: Branch Lengths of Cells",
       subtitle = "Each point represents a single cell | Ancestral trunk removed",
       y = "Branch Length (CNA Events)",
       x = "Cell Names") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, size = 6, hjust = 1), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    legend.position = "none" 
  )

ggplot(kuramochi_df, aes(x = clone, y = total_branch_length, fill = clone)) +
  # ۱. کشیدن باکس پلات در پس‌زمینه
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) + 
  
  # ۲. اضافه کردن نقاط با لرزش (Jitter)
  geom_jitter(aes(color = clone), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  
  # تنظیم دستی رنگ داخل باکس‌ها
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Kuramochi_C8" = "firebrick", 
    "Kuramochi_E10" = "forestgreen", 
    "Kuramochi_Parent" = "dodgerblue4"
  )) +
  
  # تنظیم دستی رنگ نقاط (بهتر است با رنگ باکس‌ها یکی باشد)
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Kuramochi_C8" = "firebrick", 
    "Kuramochi_E10" = "forestgreen", 
    "Kuramochi_Parent" = "dodgerblue4"
  )) +
  
  labs(title = "Kuramochi: Genomic Alteration Distribution",
       subtitle = "Boxplot with jittered points (Ancestral trunk removed)",
       y = "Total Branch Length",
       x = "Clones") +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

all populations were grown under identical conditions and for 22 cell divisions, the differences in Total Branch Length directly reflect variations in the genomic alteration rate. The higher medians in clones C8 and E10 compared to the parental population indicate that the rate of copy number alterations increased following single-cell isolation. The higher median in C8 signifies the highest rate of genomic evolution in this clone. The greater dispersion of points in C8 compared to E10 indicates more severe chromosomal instability (CIN) and the development of higher intra-clonal heterogeneity within only 22 cell generations.

  geom_point(size = 2) +

ggplot(snu119_df, aes(x = clone, y = total_branch_length, fill = clone)) +
  # ۱. کشیدن باکس پلات در پس‌زمینه
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.3, outlier.shape = NA, width = 0.5) + 
  
  # ۲. اضافه کردن نقاط با لرزش (Jitter)
  geom_jitter(aes(color = clone), width = 0.2, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  theme_minimal() +
  
  # تنظیم دستی رنگ‌ها (مشابه Kuramochi برای حفظ ثبات بصری)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(
    "Snu119_A12" = "firebrick",     # رنگ قرمز برای کلون اول
    "Snu119_F12" = "forestgreen",   # رنگ سبز برای کلون دوم (مشابه E10)
    "Snu119_parent" = "dodgerblue4" # رنگ آبی تیره برای Parent
  )) +
  
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "Snu119_A12" = "firebrick", 
    "Snu119_F12" = "forestgreen", 
    "Snu119_parent" = "dodgerblue4"
  )) +
  
  labs(title = "Snu119: Genomic Alteration Distribution",
       subtitle = "Boxplot with jittered points (Ancestral trunk removed)",
       y = "Total Branch Length",
       x = "Clones") +
  
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank()
  )

all populations were grown under identical conditions and for 22 cell divisions, the difference in Total Branch Length indicates the difference in the rate of genomic alterations. The higher median in the Parent population compared to the clones shows that single-cell bottlenecking led to the selection of subpopulations with lower genomic alteration rates. Among the clones, F12 has a slightly higher median than A12. At the same time, the greater dispersion in A12 indicates higher CIN and heterogeneity, while F12 shows more uniform genomic alterations.
